trans-unit.source: Owner of files: Set the name of the owner who will have unrestricted rights to the uploaded files in TYPO3 backend.

Require confirmation for drag & drop uploads: Ask editors to confirm the file rights checkbox before an upload through the File List or an inline file/media field (e.g. "Select & upload files") is accepted.
Require confirmation in the file browser: Ask editors to confirm the file rights checkbox before an upload through the TYPO3 file browser popup is accepted.
Store backend uploader on file: Save the uploading backend user as a reference on the uploaded sys_file record.
Store frontend uploader on file: Save the uploading frontend user as a reference on the uploaded sys_file record.
